summary: First testing pass for Stompin' Ground Yuma. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass (venue, dances list/search/filter, get by id, register/login/me, admin login, admin gating for POST /dances, tracking full CRUD, google-session endpoint reachable). Frontend: Auth (register + admin login), Home, Dances (search + difficulty chips), Dance Detail (sticky Wishlist/Mark Completed buttons, star rating & notes), My Dances (Completed/Wishlist tabs with counts), Profile (admin sees Add New Dance, Sign Out present) all verified via Playwright at mobile 390x844.

minor.issue: Server lowercases email on storage. Not a bug; tests must compare against email.lower(). Fixed in test file.

issues: Inputs and buttons lack data-testid/testID attributes; had to fall back to nth(index) selectors. Add testIDs for auth-name-input, auth-email-input, auth-password-input, auth-submit-button, auth-google-button.
Tab label is 'Dances' (not 'Library' as spec mentions). Screen title is 'Dance Library'. Consistent with UX. Add testIDs like library-search-input, difficulty-chip-<name>, dance-card-<id>.
Completed button label reads 'Mark Completed' before selection and 'Completed' after. Works as expected but confirm this is intentional wording.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Non-blocking but should be cleaned up in a component using pointerEvents prop.

action_items: Add data-testid/testID attributes to interactive elements (auth inputs & buttons, library search, difficulty chips, dance cards, wishlist/completed buttons, star icons, notes textarea, profile Add New Dance and Sign Out rows) to make future automated tests robust.
Fix deprecated 'props.pointerEvents' warning by moving to style.pointerEvents.
Optionally seed the venue city correctly (currently returns 'Yuma, Arizona' — matches spec).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py includes 'password_hash' via find_one in login flow correctly then strips in user_to_out — good. get_current_user projects out password_hash — good.
MongoDB _id excluded via projection {"_id": 0} everywhere — good.
JWT_SECRET has a fallback string; for production consider mandating env value.
Google-session endpoint calls Emergent OAuth service — cannot be end-to-end tested without a real session_id; verified it returns 401 for invalid session (not 404).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (auth, home, library, detail, tracking, my dances, profile-admin)

seed_data_creation: Registered a few TEST_ui_*/TEST_r_*/TEST_dup_* users during tests. Created and cleaned up one TEST_Dance_* via admin. Tracking row for admin on 'Amame' was left in DB (used by UI verification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tab label used in nav is 'Dances' (not 'Library'). Detail action button text: 'Wishlist' + 'Mark Completed' (toggles to 'Completed' after selection). Admin creds work: admin@stompinground.com / Admin123!. When testing Playwright, prefer role/text selectors as testIDs are not yet added.
